card.name: Space or digit before a number
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before a number in dose or lab text, such as the gap before 56 hours or the 1 in 120 mg. It is most often seen in cardiac drug labels (amlodipine, diltiazem).

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A bare space token right before a number after "is" or "than".

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A leading digit or decimal point within a dose or year.

card.writes: Promotes odd word pieces and suppresses dam/reservoir words, so no clear meaning for the output.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a number is written, mostly in cardiac drug dose or half-life statements.
